transcript.question: Tell me about your background and what motivated you to apply for the Senior Full-Stack Engineer (React / Node.js) position.
transcript.candidateResponse: I have been engineering distributed systems for over 6.2 years, focusing on high availability, clean domain architectures, and mentoring developers.
transcript.keyInsights: Strong clarity, direct role alignment, concise articulation.

transcript.question: Can you walk me through a challenging problem you solved using react in a production environment?
transcript.candidateResponse: In our last project, we handled 50,000 requests/sec by introducing async worker queues, Redis caching layers, and database sharding.
transcript.keyInsights: Demonstrated deep practical familiarity with high-scale constraints and distributed caching.

transcript.question: Tell me about a time you handled a difficult customer escalation or critical production outage under high pressure.
transcript.candidateResponse: When a critical payment webhook failed during peak traffic, I orchestrated a rollback within 4 minutes, triggered automated replay from Kafka, and led a blameless post-mortem.
transcript.keyInsights: Calm situational leadership, methodical root-cause analysis.
